sun2026.note: PMID matches; preprint on bioRxiv (PubMed date 2026-06-26, MAGENTA cohort: AA n=224, CH n=209, NHW n=235). Caveat: the abstract does NOT report a clear ancestry bias against non-European groups; the highest discrimination was in the African American high-PIP set, which the authors attribute to fine-mapping resolution, LD and annotation composition. Do not cite it as showing worse performance in non-European ancestries; cite it for weak agreement with eQTL effect sizes and use as a prioritization tool. Author order in PubMed: Sun, Mews, Wheeler, Benchek, ... Bush (last). Do not describe as peer reviewed.
